authority: orchestrating engineer after independent Astra review, Terra acceptance tests, root code/SQL challenge and final integrated checks
scope: Private evidence/provenance/decision history, scoped logical removal, integrity quarantine and source-response intake seam. No source activation, public admission or deployment.

acceptance_criteria.AC-WP05-01: Verified exact old/new representation hashes and literal historical evidence; original bytes differ from normalized text.
acceptance_criteria.AC-WP05-02: Invalid quotes, UTF16 boundaries, typed JSON pointers, lossy/duplicate JSON and mismatched source binding fail with unchanged D1 tables.
acceptance_criteria.AC-WP05-03: Durable idempotent replay, explicit unchanged-byte observation, tombstoned/quarantined current availability, no old-key or new-grant resurrection.
acceptance_criteria.AC-WP05-04: Three mirrors count once; actual retirement/complete member transfer/split invalidates dependent decisions; provisional source-response provenance cannot count as reviewed origin.
acceptance_criteria.AC-WP05-05: Contradictory claims and corrected decision history retained with policy/evidence digests, exact scope, authenticated-capability fixture binding and one head change.
acceptance_criteria.AC-WP05-06: Failed refresh does not renew health; scoped removal erases all owned revisions and unused rationales, preserves unrelated material, works after expiry and denies regrants.

validation.local_ops_smoke: pass; fake bindings and injected fetch only

limits: Capability and issued-request resolvers are synthetic in tests; no real authentication, provider permission or legal sufficiency is established.
WP06 must implement actual registry qualification, lease/budget/issued-request predicates in the same retention transaction; WP07 must compose one atomic raw/observation/page/checkpoint commit.
WP14 must implement selector-to-reviewed-origin adjudication, requalification after grant renewal and the catalog/public removal bridge.
Quarantine verifies stored hashes and transform consistency within one bounded SQL read; it does not resist coherent unrestricted database rewrite or prove source truth.
Removal is logical current-DB removal with explicitly permitted minimal audit metadata; WP26 owns backup/restore reconciliation.
Four high advisories in unchanged lockfile remain a release blocker; E01-E06 not run; no deployment.
